items.prompt:
Repaint input 1 as one square finished game spell illustration, 恶魔之力, in broad opaque hand-painted anime style.
REFERENCE ROLES: Input 1 is the COMPOSITION TARGET: preserve its head-to-waist half-body crop, young priestess on left turned three-quarter to the right looking calmly back at viewer, one human palm opened at lower-right shoulder/chest height, other hand quietly near wrist/waist, and ONE spectral claw floating beyond the palm in the right upper half. Keep its muted neutral gray background with one broad darker shadow plane, simplified into quiet painterly masses. Never substitute white, red streak networks, scenery or a full-body pose. Input 2 (curse-drain.webp) and input 3 (curse-silence.webp) lock Xingyue's DARK PRIESTESS identity and broad-brush painting language, not their poses, red spell shapes or background layouts.

Correct identity to the character in references 2 and 3: calm composed anime face, violet eyes, relaxed brows and closed neutral mouth, extremely pale low-saturation golden hair following the REFERENCES' actual visible pale ivory/gray warm-cool colors. Dense straight fringe across the forehead, smooth rounded crown, two long straight cheek sidelocks, one thick low side braid falling on the left quiet side in this composition. Remove the target's sweeping side-part hair mass, excessive flyaways and fine hair strands. Add the dark indigo crescent hair ornament clipped flat above the bangs at viewer-right as in reference 2. Black-gray HIGH-COLLARED PRIESTESS ROBE, muted purple cape with sparse gold edging, BLACK CLOTH GLOVES on both hands. Replace the target's white/chrome-looking gloves and shiny sculpted bodice with quiet dark matte cloth, natural fingers and connected wrists. Keep connected shoulder, chest and waist anatomy.
The floating spectral claw is ONE connected purple-black dark silhouette, slightly larger than her human hand, readable curved fingers and one broad wrist taper toward the opened palm. Preserve its position and gesture but reduce the vivid neon magenta to deep muted violet with a narrow concentrated cool-violet edge and a few broad violet planes. It should look like a restrained summoned shadow extension of the gesture, not an extra human arm or a glove. A tiny muted crimson accent may sit at the glove-shadow transition, never crossing face or eyes. Face first, hand gesture second, shadow claw third. No extra claws, characters, horns, wings, particles or symbols.

STYLE: rough hand-painted anime illustration built from large connected opaque masses and a limited set of wide directional curved or elongated swipes and blunt dabs. Clear grouped light/shadow and decisive handmade edges, selected overlaps and broken stroke endings surrounded by quiet regions. Do not flatten every interior or texture every surface.
HAIR: coherent substantial locks and large braid sections, quiet pale base regions, one or a few broad shadow turns and short irregular opaque highlights. No tiny facets, pale scratches, strand networks or dense flyaways.
FACE: clear expressive anime upper lids, simple violet iris masses and a few crisp highlights; economical nose and mouth, broad cheek planes. Preserve fringe cast shadow, restrained nose underside plane, under-jaw and neck turn, a few tapered colored accents at lower lids and jaw-to-neck transition. No polished beauty shading.
CLOTH AND HANDS: principal broad cape and robe folds follow shoulder, chest, elbows and waist. A few selective crease accents at collar and tension points, one or two broad midtone turns connecting volume, large quiet dark areas. Gloved fingers anatomically clear without dense joint detail. Sparse gold trim painted as a few broad accents. No disconnected angular mosaics, dense wrinkle networks or shiny materials.
Muted charcoal, gray, ivory hair, restrained purple cape and concentrated violet eyes/edge light; background subordinate and economical. Avoid photoreal skin, glossy 3D, smooth airbrush, uniformly traced outlines, all-over grain/canvas filters, tiny facets, excessive glow or ornamental clutter. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
